description: A public collection of agent templates for the Gamut app.

agents.name: Agent Pill
agents.description: Onboarding agent that interviews you, snoops your tools (with permission), and builds your highest-impact first Gamut agent -- both as a created agent and a copyable prompt.

agents.name: Nutrition Agent
agents.description: Track calories, macros, and body weight with fast meal logging, a visual dashboard, and smart goal setting

agents.name: Office Manager
agents.description: Keeps the team fed — runs weekly kitchen stock orders, handles one-off Slack requests, and organizes daily lunch/dinner orders

agents.name: OpenSlide Studio
agents.description: Slide studio built on OpenSlide — creates, edits, and presents React-based slide decks in a native dashboard with a searchable deck library, live-updating previews, reusable themes, and inspector-comment editing.

agents.name: Outbound Campaign Agent
agents.description: Runs an end-to-end personalized outbound motion: ICP qualification, sourcing, enrichment, fail-closed suppression, linted drafting, capped sending, cadence, reply detection, and calendar-sourced meeting reporting. Vendor-neutral through swappable adapters.

agents.name: Recruiting Agent
agents.description: Owns the hiring pipeline end-to-end — sourcing, filtering, outbound, nurture, and interview scheduling, with a self-improving screening filter calibrated by your feedback.

agents.name: SEO Agent
agents.description: Autonomous SEO specialist — owns content engine, link building + outreach, technical SEO, and weekly strategy/reporting for one website, end to end.
